{
  "analysis": "The keyframe OCR quality is good - I can see clear commands like 'get egg', 'set nut', 'u', 'n', 'e'. The keyframes come in close pairs (33ms apart) capturing character-by-character typing. I need to OCR all keyframes and diff them to extract complete commands. But 861 frames is a lot, so I should first deduplicate by keeping one frame per time cluster, then OCR those.",
  "plan": "Write a Python script to select one representative keyframe per ~0.4s time cluster, reducing the total count. Then OCR those frames and write a script to diff consecutive OCR outputs and extract the complete command that was typed before each game response.",
  "commands": [
    {
      "keystrokes": "cat > /app/select_keyframes.py << 'PYEOF'
import subprocess, re, os, shutil

result = subprocess.run(['ffmpeg', '-y', '-i', '/app/video.mp4', '-vf', r'select=gt(scene\,0.005),showinfo', '-vsync', 'vfr', '-f', 'null', '-'],
                       capture_output=True, text=True)
stderr = result.stderr
times = []
for m in re.finditer(r'showinfo.*pts_time:([\d.]+)', stderr):
    times.append(float(m.group(1)))

# Cluster: keep one frame per 0.4s window
selected = []
last_t = -10
for i, t in enumerate(times):
    if t - last_t >= 0.4:
        selected.append((i+1, t))  # keyframe number is 1-indexed
        last_t = t

print(f"Total keyframes: {len(times)}")
print(f"Selected keyframes: {len(selected)}")

os.makedirs('/app/selected_keyframes', exist_ok=True)
for idx, t in selected:
    src = f'/app/keyframes/key_{idx:04d}.png'
    dst = f'/app/selected_keyframes/kf_{idx:04d}_{t:.3f}.png'
    if os.path.exists(src):
        shutil.copy(src, dst)

print("Done selecting keyframes")
PYEOF
python3 /app/select_keyframes.py
